steps.headline: Groups are now Waiting for you, On and Paused; a job's page is a chip on its card.
steps.notice: Weekly briefing, Money and Recipe notes show as chips.

steps.headline: The app's own model picker, the Library's tab strip, and the limit as one setting row.
steps.changed: B-sub and B-details: the Model card uses the picker from Settings and Specialists; Settings / Runs uses the Library's Plugins / Themes strip; Spending is one row with the limit at the right.

steps.headline: Each permission shows its state as a pill (Always allowed / Asks first) that opens a small menu with Remove.
steps.changed: B-add: the per-row Allow / Ask strips are replaced by the shared status pill with a menu, the way your status in Games works. The bin moved into that menu.
steps.notice: Anything not listed uses the same pill (Never / Asks first).

steps.headline: New automation has no switch: Create turns it on.
steps.notice: Pausing it happens afterwards, from its card.
